sources.title: Albanian MFA reports Morocco's Embassy notification of a short-stay waiver
sources.publisher: Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs of Albania
sources.officialityEvidence: Actual complete 14 August 2026 official Albanian Ministry publication read. It expressly attributes the visa-waiver decision and notification to Morocco's Embassy accredited to Albania in Rome and states commencement on 15 August. This is a strong issuer-government lead about a destination diplomatic notification, but no operative Moroccan text or ordinary-passport schedule was recovered in this pass, so it is not promoted as rank-grade destination proof.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This decision will enter into force on August 15, 2026.

unresolved.reason: A current ordinary Albanian visitor rule is not established by recovered destination-authority evidence. Albania's Ministry explicitly reports a Moroccan Embassy notification of a short-stay waiver from 15 August 2026, but Morocco's French and English consular schedules returned Request Rejected and the formerly recorded public Acces Maroc conditions API returned 404. The current portal shell and older conditioned-eVisa briefing do not resolve the actual Albanian ordinary-passport scope. Do not retain prior-visa liability as newly verified or promote a nationality-wide waiver or ninety-day stay solely from issuer reporting or upstream labels.
